'''Silk''' was a fabric, often used in luxury goods.

It came in many varieties, including [[Aeien silk/Legends|Aeien silk]],<ref name="TVD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Cyrene silk/Legends|Cyrene silk]],<ref name="E1VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and [[dreamsilk]].<ref name="Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>
